people.search: Search by handle, name or email
people.name: Member
people.privacy: Reading history, subscriptions and likes are private. Admins never see them.

history.signOut: Signed out of {n, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}

invites.search: Search by code, inviter or email
invites.name: Code or email
invites.waitingCount: {n, plural, =0 {Nobody} one {# address} other {# addresses}} waiting to sign in
invites.revokeNote: Revoking also cancels the invitations waiting on this code, for good: an undo opens the code again, but those addresses must ask to join again.
invites.memberNote: A member's code admits one person. It counts toward their five until it is revoked unused.
invites.holdNote: The address shows only here. The audit log names this invitation by its number, never by the address.

history.created: Made, for {n, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}

reports.search: Search by name, handle, blog or the words given
reports.name: Reported
reports.privacy: Reporters are named here and nowhere else. Nobody they reported is told who did.
reports.gonePerson: a member whose account is gone

apps.search: Search by name, developer, client ID or address
apps.name: App

notes.draft: A draft: only its owner’s account can connect it, so its developer can test it. Approve it to offer it to every member.
notes.approved: Any member can connect it. Lowering what it may do, or taking the email away, reaches its live tokens at once.
notes.suspended: Cut off: every token it holds is refused. Its connections are kept, so Restore brings it back for the members who connected it.
notes.private: The console counts who connected an app, never who they are.

history.ended: Ended {n, plural, one {# connection} other {# connections}}

form.name: Name
form.contactHint: Where you write about approval, changes and a cut-off. Members never see it.
form.urlHint: Both https, and both linked on the page where members connect the app.
form.redirectHint: One a line, at most {n}: http://127.0.0.1/… or http://[::1]/… (any port matches), or the app’s own scheme, such as com.example.app:/callback. Never localhost.
form.maxScope: The most it may ask for
form.allowEmail: May ask to see the member’s email address
form.ownerHint: The account a draft connects for, so its developer can test it. Optional.
form.limitHint: Empty for the default, {n}; 0 for none.

errors.name: Give it a name of up to {name} characters.
errors.developer: Say who made it, in up to {text} characters.
errors.contactEmail: A contact address is needed, one that receives mail.
errors.homepageUrl: The homepage must be an https address.
errors.privacyUrl: The privacy policy must be an https address.
errors.redirectUris: One to {n} redirect URIs, each different: a loopback address over http, or the app’s own reverse-DNS scheme. Never localhost, never https.
errors.maxScope: Choose how much it may ask for.
errors.allowEmail: Choose whether it may ask for the email address.
errors.owner: That is not a handle. Leave it empty for no owner.
errors.perMemberPerMin: A whole number from 0, or empty for the default.
errors.perAppPerMin: A whole number from 0, or empty for the default.
errors.maxConnections: A whole number from 0, or empty for no limit.
